description: This Java source file defines the HttpViewHandler class, which extends AbstractViewHandler and provides functionality for rendering web views by fetching HTTP resources and writing them to HTTP responses. It includes methods for initialization, preparing the view context, and rendering content, with error handling and debug logging.

classes.name: HttpViewHandler
classes.description: A class that handles rendering web views by retrieving HTML content over HTTP and writing it to the response stream.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the view handler with a servlet context. Currently, the method is empty and does not perform any initialization.

methods.name: prepareViewContext
methods.description: Prepares and returns a view context map. In this implementation, it returns an empty map.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Fetches content from a specified URL using HttpClient and writes it to the HttpServletResponse. Handles IO exceptions and HTTP client exceptions, with optional debug logging.
